answer: Make new identities pay with time, not just stake: a fresh agent starts like a sparrow on a narrow jetty, allowed only tiny actions while each epoch of honest work it completes is scored by randomly drawn peers. Influence then grows like karst erosion, slowly and cumulatively, so a sybil farm must sustain thousands of identities doing real graded work for weeks before any vote matters, making mass fakes far costlier than the rewards they could capture.
